rules.guidance: Perform malaria RDT. If positive: treat with Artemether-Lumefantrine (Coartem). Check for anaemia. Give paracetamol for fever.
Perform Widal test and blood culture if available. Treat with Ciprofloxacin 500mg twice daily for 7 days. Ensure adequate hydration.
If mild: Amoxicillin 500mg three times daily for 5 days. If severe or no improvement: escalate to doctor.
Check BP twice. If above 160/100: start Amlodipine 5mg once daily. Advise low salt diet. Refer for confirmation if newly diagnosed.
Start oral rehydration salts immediately. If bloody diarrhoea: add Metronidazole 400mg three times daily for 5 days. Monitor hydration status.
Perform urinalysis. Treat with Nitrofurantoin 100mg twice daily for 5 days. Encourage increased water intake.
Check PCV or FBC. Give Ferrous Sulphate 200mg twice daily. Check for underlying cause. Review diet.
Clean wound thoroughly. Give Amoxicillin-Clavulanate 625mg twice daily for 5 days if infected. Apply topical antiseptic.
